window_coordinate_axis: mm10/GRCm38 chr17, 5-kb windows; same axis as existing stage5 tracks
genotype_call_policy: PASS biallelic SNPs only; standard diploid calls complete; carrier homozygotes contribute their allele; carrier heterozygotes contribute the unique allele only if absent from all same-subspecies standard chromosomes, otherwise masked
limitations: variant-only VCF; no invariant callable denominator
sitewise pseudo-t alleles do not resolve phase across loci
PASS VCF analysis uses GT only; no read-level DP/GQ filters
standard groups include geographic structure within subspecies
